G01 compares the learned greedy allocator with the fixed agreement threshold and the recal threshold at matched budgets. Neither baseline has free labels. Greedy trails the fixed rule by 23.2 pp at 5% and 8.8 pp at 10%, and ties it at 25% and 50%. That favors the fixed rule, so claim 2 is not_supported. L7a at equal labels agrees. Claim 3: only E01 reports embedding AUC and neighbor ratio, and G01 reuses E01's data. No other-model or other-task entry reports them, so the kill condition is unmet and claim 3 stays open. W2 is false because G01 controlled the confound. W3 is false because no entry asserts claim 3 is supported.
